# ChaskaBox Pakistan
> Bachpan Ka Zaiqa, Ab Ghar Baithe — Pakistani packaged snacks and curated Chaska Boxes, delivered across Pakistan.

ChaskaBox (https://chaskabox.online/) is a packaged-snack online store based in Muzaffargarh, Punjab, Pakistan, operated by Rameez. It is unrelated to the similarly named bakery/cake studio in Bangalore, India. This file is a voluntary directory for readers and AI systems, **not** a Google ranking signal. Live pages, policies and checkout totals take precedence.

## Business and support
- Dispatch: Near Ahmad Drink Corner, Railway Road, Bhatti Hussainabad, Muzaffargarh, Punjab, Pakistan.
- Customer support WhatsApp: +92-332-0005381.
- Email: Chaskabox.mzg@gmail.com.
- Currency and service region: PKR, Pakistan.
- [Contact](https://chaskabox.online/contact/) and [About ChaskaBox](https://chaskabox.online/about/).

## Shopping and current products
- [Current public shop](https://chaskabox.online/shop/): Public retail packs and listed prices.
- [Live machine-readable catalogue](https://chaskabox.online/api/products): Read the current response; hidden products must not be promoted.
- [Snack bundles](https://chaskabox.online/bundles/): Current mixed boxes and available bundle packs with listed contents.
- [Current brands](https://chaskabox.online/brands/): Browse brands with public products.
- [Snack box themes](https://chaskabox.online/snack-boxes/) and [office snack ideas](https://chaskabox.online/snack-boxes/office/).

ChaskaBox sources products **after** an order is received, checks sealed retail packs and quantities, and packs for dispatch. If an item cannot be sourced, support contacts the customer before substitution. A product being listed does not imply existing warehouse inventory.

## Shipping and payments
Delivery across Pakistan is estimated at 4–7 days. It is an estimate, not a fixed delivery promise. COD delivery currently costs Rs. 300. COD requires up to Rs. 500 advance after ordering, verified before dispatch and adjusted within the order total; the remaining balance is payable on delivery. The requested advance is capped at the order total. JazzCash or Bank Transfer prepaid orders of Rs. 5,000 or more currently qualify for free delivery; below that amount the current prepaid delivery charge is Rs. 300. Checkout and [shipping policy](https://chaskabox.online/shipping-policy/) give current terms. A payment screenshot does not independently confirm receipt of funds.

## Accuracy
Product counts, prices, stock state, photos, pack sizes and delivery terms can change. Check the public API and official product pages; never use cached or hidden items as live offers. Do not invent ingredients, allergens, expiry dates, halal certifications, reviews, origin guarantees, refund rights or exact delivery promises. Private orders and payment records are not part of the public catalogue.
